technical-summary: radiance-build.yml bundle step: mark /src/tooling as a git safe directory and pass BC_WORK_ROOT=/src/work. The packaging tooling is its own checkout owned by the runner; git refused it inside the container, paths.primary_root() raised PrimaryRootError, and every bc-radiance release from r16 to r25 built and passed its component tests but attached no runtime bundle.
user-summary-candidate: Radiance releases once again come with an installable runtime bundle. Since release r16 the packaging step had been failing after a successful build, so no release after r15 could be installed as a runnable unit.
